sloka: विचरन्ति वन अन्तेषु तानि द्रक्ष्यसि राघव ।सरित्प्रस्रवणप्रस्थान् दरीकन्धरनिर्घरान् ॥२-५४-४२॥
transliteration: vicaranti vana anteṣu tāni drakṣyasi rāghava ।saritprasravaṇaprasthān darīkandharanirgharān ॥2-54-42॥

translations.english: Your heart will be filled with joy while you wander with Sita beholding rivers, waterfalls, plateaus, caverns and mountaintorrents.
